title: How to mass-apply for jobs using AI agents

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if AI could help people apply for hundreds of jobs in minutes — but at what cost to human labor?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Today, AI can auto-generate resumes, tailor cover letters, and scrape job boards using NLP and scraping bots.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But mass-applying could devalue human skills, flood markets, and lead to AI-generated resumes replacing real candidates.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Builders are integrating filters to ensure AI only applies to roles where the human can meaningfully contribute.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In the future, AI might act as a co-pilot, helping people apply smarter, not faster, while preserving human agency.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future lies in AI that empowers, not replaces — balancing speed with integrity in the job market.

video_cue: A person reviewing AI-generated job applications on a screen, with a side view of a human recruiter nodding in approval.
